versions.content: Alarm action and Task property must fit together If an Alarm uses the action to replenish a budget then the Task referenced by OsAlarm- BudgetReplenishRef must have have OsTaskTimingProtectionDeferrable- Server enabled. If this is not the case the consistency check shall issue an error.
